input.summary: Condition RevMed's Change-of-Control assignment on Sanofi's consent (not unreasonably withheld) and bar assignment to a Sanofi competitor.
input.comment: [Playbook] We kept Sanofi's affiliate and successor assignment rights untouched, but RevMed should not be able to hand this collaboration to any acquirer without our consent: we made RevMed's Change-of-Control assignment subject to Sanofi's consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and barred assignment to a Sanofi competitor.

ops.oldText: (ii) Either Party may, without consent of the other Party, assign this Agreement in whole to (i) in the case of RevMed, its successor in interest or assignee or purchaser, as applicable, in the case of a Change of Control or (ii) in the case of Sanofi,
